# pcd_lb_member (Resource)

Manages a member (backend) of an Octavia load balancer pool in PCD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-lb-net"
}

resource "pcd_networking_subnet" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  cidr       = "10.0.0.0/24"
}

resource "pcd_lb_loadbalancer" "example" {
  name          = "tf-example-lb"
  vip_subnet_id = pcd_networking_subnet.example.id
}

resource "pcd_lb_pool" "example" {
  name            = "tf-example-pool"
  loadbalancer_id = pcd_lb_loadbalancer.example.id
  protocol        = "HTTP"
  lb_method       = "ROUND_ROBIN"
}

resource "pcd_lb_member" "example" {
  pool_id       = pcd_lb_pool.example.id
  address       = "10.0.0.10"
  protocol_port = 8080
  subnet_id     = pcd_networking_subnet.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The IP address of the backend member. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `pool_id` (String) The pool this member belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `protocol_port` (Number) The port the backend member listens on. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) The administrative state of the member.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether this is a backup member (only receives traffic when non-backup members are down).
- `monitor_address` (String) Alternate IP address used for health monitoring.
- `monitor_port` (Number) Alternate port used for health monitoring.
- `name` (String) The name of the member.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `subnet_id` (String) The subnet the member address is on. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the member.
- `weight` (Number) Relative share of traffic this member receives (0 disables).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The member ID.
- `operating_status` (String) The operating status.
- `provisioning_status` (String) The provisioning status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_lb_member.example <pool_id>/<member_id>
```
